description: This file defines an internal struct 'CommitQueue<T>' that implements a circular buffer data structure for managing sorted transaction records, primarily used within the Orleans.Transactions namespace for transaction management.

classes.name: CommitQueue<T>
classes.description: A circular buffer data structure for storing transaction records sorted by timestamp, supporting operations such as add, remove, clear, and binary search.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a transaction record to the queue, resizing underlying buffer if needed, and ensures records are added in timestamp order.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all transaction records from the queue.

methods.name: RemoveFromFront
methods.description: Removes a specified number of records from the front of the queue.

methods.name: RemoveFromBack
methods.description: Removes a specified number of records from the back of the queue.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Performs a binary search to locate a transaction record by TransactionId and timestamp.

methods.name: Elements
methods.description: Returns an enumerable of all transaction records in the queue.

methods.name: First
methods.description: Returns the first transaction record in the queue.

methods.name: Last
methods.description: Returns the last transaction record in the queue.
